xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: xbrief sole public canonical name; vBRIEF legacy

plan.title: docs/product: vBRIEF is legacy — xbrief sole public canonical work-state name

narratives.Description: Consumer layout and disk SoT use xbrief/, but public docs, glossary, skills, and README still teach vBRIEF as current. This story makes xbrief/xBRIEF the sole public canonical name and labels vBRIEF legacy everywhere it remains.
narratives.Overview: Adoption and agent confusion bug; migrate paths stay for history.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer or agent reading Directive docs, I want xbrief as the only current work-state name, so that I do not treat vBRIEF and xbrief as two competing present-day models.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit docs/CONCEPTS.md and content/glossary.md files so xbrief is the sole current work-state name and vBRIEF entries are marked legacy with pointers. Step 2: Edit README.md and content/docs/getting-started.md (and QUICK-START if present) module strings that teach current vBRIEF paths. Step 3: Add a short legacy map section in content/UPGRADING.md or CONCEPTS. Step 4: Content-contract tests where practical; CHANGELOG cites #2907. Verification: run content-contract unit tests and task check:merge.

narrative.Acceptance: Given README QUICK-START CONCEPTS ARCHITECTURE glossary and user-facing skills, when read for current guidance, then work-state and lifecycle use xbrief/xBRIEF only.
Given docs, when vBRIEF appears, then it is labeled legacy/historical with a single authoritative rename/history note.

items.title: Glossary and CLI strings prefer xbrief

narrative.Acceptance: Given glossary and doctor/help copy, when rendered, then lifecycle terms are under xbrief; vbrief task aliases if kept have deprecation notices.
Given the PR, when search and tests run, then user-facing current-guidance vBRIEF is zero outside legacy/migrate/changelog/archive and CHANGELOG cites #2907.
